AgentsConfig.description: The `[agents]` section: per-stage executor selection and budgets.

AuthConfig.description:
Authentication settings.

Controls token lifetime defaults.

token_ttl_hours.description:
Default token lifetime in hours.

Defaults to 8760 (~1 year).

DatabaseConfig.description:
Configuration for the database connection pools.

Loaded from the application YAML configuration file.  The `url` field is required; all other fields have sensible defaults for local development.

Two pools are created from this configuration: one for MCP read-path queries and one for worker write-path transactions.  Pool-specific settings (max connections, statement timeout) are selected by the startup sequence based on the pool name.

acquire_timeout_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait when acquiring a connection before returning an error.

max_connect_attempts.description: Maximum connection attempts during startup (used by the startup sequence, not by this module directly).

pool_mcp_max_connections.description: Maximum connections in the MCP (read-path) pool.

pool_worker_max_connections.description: Maximum connections in the worker (write-path) pool.

statement_timeout_mcp_ms.description: Statement timeout in milliseconds for MCP pool connections.

statement_timeout_worker_ms.description: Statement timeout in milliseconds for worker pool connections.

DiscoveryConfig.description:
Configuration for the discovery (semantic search) handler.

Controls result limits, overfetch behaviour, and similarity thresholds.

default_limit.description: Default number of results when the caller does not specify a limit.

max_limit.description: Maximum number of results a caller may request.

overfetch_multiplier.description:
Multiplier applied to the limit for the initial semantic search.

`K = limit * overfetch_multiplier` rows are fetched, then filtered by similarity threshold.

similarity_threshold.description: Minimum cosine similarity to include a result.

ExecutorChoice.description: Which executor a stage's binding selects.

oneOf.description: The single completion call, with no tools.
The in-process turn loop with stage-scoped tools.

ExplorationConfig.description:
Configuration for the exploration (graph traversal) handler.

Controls depth and result limits.

default_depth.description: Default traversal depth when not specified by the caller.

default_limit.description: Default number of results when the caller does not specify a limit.

max_limit.description: Maximum number of results a caller may request.

InferenceConfig.description:
Per-stage inference configuration.

Each stage is independently configurable to allow cost/quality tuning — e.g. a capable model for extraction and a fast/cheap model for classification stages.

InitConfig.description: Fresh-system seed values, applied only when first creating a corpus.

InitEmbeddingConfig.description: The genesis embedding identity used to seed the first profile.

dimensions.description: Target output dimensionality. `None` resolves through the embedding service's native-dimension chain when the genesis profile is created.

LimitsConfig.description:
Per-provider concurrency limits.

Bounds in-flight requests to any single external service, preventing worker tasks from starving MCP read-path queries that share the same provider.

providers.description:
Per-provider limits, keyed by provider kind.

Pre-populated with a default for every provider kind.  Typed keys mean a YAML typo fails at parse time rather than silently creating an unreferenced entry.

oneOf.description:
Structured JSON output, one object per line (JSONL).

Includes level, target, span context, timestamp, and message. Suitable for log aggregation and machine parsing.

Human-readable coloured output for terminal use.

Uses `tracing-subscriber`'s pretty formatter with ANSI colours when writing to a TTY.
Write log output to standard error.
Write log output to a rolling file in [`LoggingConfig::file_directory`].

LoggingConfig.description:
Configuration for the tracing subscriber.

Loaded from the application configuration file.  All fields have sensible defaults for local development (info level, JSON format, stderr output).

file_directory.description:
Directory for log file output when [`output`](LoggingConfig::output) is [`LogOutput::File`].

Resolved at startup via platform-aware defaults: `dirs::state_dir` → `dirs::data_local_dir` → `std::env::temp_dir`, each joined with `tribal/logs`.

file_rotation.description:
Log file rotation policy.

Defaults to [`FileRotation::Daily`].

format.description:
Output format for log lines.

Defaults to [`LogFormat::Json`] for structured output suitable for log aggregation.

include_llm_content.description:
Whether to include raw LLM request/response content in log output.

Defaults to `false`.  When `true`, inference-related spans and events may include prompt text and model responses, which can be large and contain sensitive information.

level.description:
Tracing filter directive string.

Supports per-module granularity, e.g. `"info,tribal_db=debug"`. Defaults to `"info"`.  The `TRIBAL_LOG` environment variable, mapped by the configuration loader, takes precedence over a YAML-supplied value for this field.

output.description:
Output destination for log lines.

Defaults to [`LogOutput::Stderr`].

OAuthConfig.description:
OAuth 2.1 authorisation-server configuration.

`issuer_url` is the canonical authorisation-server identifier; `resource_url` is the canonical resource identifier the AS issues audience-bound tokens for. When either is `None`, the consumer derives it from the server bind address at startup.

issuer_url.description: Canonical authorisation-server issuer URL. Derived from the server bind address when omitted.

resource_url.description: Canonical protected-resource URL. Derived from the server bind address plus `/mcp` when omitted.

PromptSource.description:
Where the active prompts are loaded from.

`Embedded` reads the six prompts compiled into the binary via `include_str!`. `Disk` reads them from `directory`, writing the embedded defaults on first run if files are missing; setting `hot_reload: true` spawns a watcher that reloads on file change.

The shape makes invalid states unrepresentable — `hot_reload` is only reachable when an on-disk source actually exists.

oneOf.description:
Prompts compiled into the binary.

Empty struct variant rather than a unit variant: serde's `deny_unknown_fields` is only honoured for struct-variant arms of internally-tagged enums, so the empty braces are what make `{kind: embedded, hot_reload: true}` fail to deserialise.
Prompts read from a directory on disk.

directory.description: Directory containing prompt template files. Supports tilde (`~`).

hot_reload.description: Whether to watch for file changes and reload automatically.

PromptsConfig.description:
Wrapper around [`PromptSource`].

A struct rather than an inline enum so future prompt-wide knobs (e.g. global cache settings) can land without breaking the YAML schema.

source.description: Where the active prompts are loaded from.

ProviderConnectionConfig.description: One reusable provider endpoint and credential.

oneOf.description: A local or remotely hosted Ollama endpoint.

ProviderLimitsConfig.description: Concurrency and timeout limits for a single provider.

ServerConfig.description:
Top-level server configuration.

Controls the transport protocol, bind address, shutdown behaviour, and SSE-specific tuning.

bind_address.description:
Socket address to bind the HTTP/SSE listener to.

`None` when using stdio transport.  When transport is HTTP or SSE and this is `None`, the startup sequence supplies [`DEFAULT_BIND_ADDRESS`] (`127.0.0.1:8725`) as a fallback.

job_state_hard_ttl_seconds.description: Hard upper bound on watch-channel entry lifetime regardless of terminal state, in seconds.

job_state_ttl_seconds.description: How long to retain a watch-channel entry after the job reaches a terminal state, in seconds.

transport.description: Transport protocol for the MCP server.

SseConfig.description:
SSE-specific connection settings.

Nested under `server.sse` in the configuration file.

idle_timeout_ms.description: Close SSE connection if no real events for this many milliseconds.

keepalive_interval_ms.description:
SSE comment keepalive interval in milliseconds.

Prevents proxy timeouts on idle connections.

max_connection_age_ms.description:
Maximum SSE connection lifetime in milliseconds.

Forces re-authentication after this period.

execution_deadline_seconds.description: Override for the execution deadline, in seconds; the named default applies when absent.

executor.description: The executor the stage runs under.

max_total_tokens.description: Override for the token cap; the named default applies when absent.

max_turns.description: Override for the turn cap; the named default applies when absent.

verifier.description: Whether an accepted submission is verified by a child execution. Absent leaves the stage's loop default in force: triage and relation verify by default, extraction has no verifier. It is honoured only under the loop executor; setting it under one-shot, where there is no submission loop to verify, is inert and surfaced as a startup advisory.

StageInferenceConfig.description: Configuration for a single inference stage.

max_tokens.description: Maximum output tokens. `None` uses the provider default.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. `None` uses the provider default.

file_directory.description:
Directory for trace file output.

Resolved at startup via platform-aware defaults: `dirs::data_local_dir` → `std::env::temp_dir`, each joined with `tribal/traces`.

TransportKind.description: Protocol used to serve MCP traffic.

WorkerConfig.description:
Configuration for the worker loop.

All duration fields are expressed as integer milliseconds and converted to [`Duration`] via convenience methods.  Defaults are applied via `serde(default)` so that an empty YAML object deserialises to a valid configuration.

heartbeat_interval_ms.description: Milliseconds between heartbeat updates for claimed tasks.

max_candidates_per_job.description: Maximum candidate count per job (cap applied during extraction).

max_concurrent_tasks.description: Maximum number of concurrently executing tasks.

tag_similarity_threshold.description: Minimum cosine similarity for semantic tag matching (0.0, 1.0].

task_max_retries.description: Maximum retries before a task is dead-lettered.

triage_search_limit.description: Number of similar items returned during triage search.

schema.description:
Top-level configuration for the Tribal server.

All fields default to sensible values for local development.

init.description: Fresh-system genesis seed values (applied only when first creating a corpus).

version.description:
Schema version, set automatically to the crate version.

Used to detect stale configuration files that may need migration.
